title: fuzzlab identity/ownership graph (Phase 2, CR-LAB-0001 §8, L-P2.1)
description: Named test identities, the resources they own, and the authz expectations that connect an accessing identity to a target resource and a binary expected outcome (D20's binary-verdict convention: allowed | denied). Deliberately decoupled from the manifest/Cell IR the same way lab/patterns/provenance.yaml is decoupled from it (CR-LAB-0001 Addendum A) — fuzzlab.labgen.verdict.verdict() never reads this file or its loader, fuzzlab.labgen.identity.

schema_version.description: Version of this file's shape, independent of manifest_version/safety_matrix_version — this file is never read by the verdict engine.

id.description: Opaque identity ID, unique within this file, e.g. user_a, admin_a.

role.description: The identity's role, e.g. standard_user, admin. Not an enum: new roles may be added without a schema change.

resource_id.description: Opaque resource ID, unique within this file, e.g. profile_user_a.

owner.description: The identity id that owns this resource. Cross-referenced against identities[].id at load time (fuzzlab.labgen.identity), not enforced by this schema alone.

cell_ids.description: Which generated manifest cells this resource maps to. A one-directional annotation only: the manifest/Cell IR carries no reference back to this file, mirroring provenance.yaml's one-directional cell_id -> [card_id, ...] shape.

cell_id.description: The manifest cell this authz expectation is about.

endpoint.description: The endpoint path being accessed, e.g. /profile/{id}.

accessing_identity.description: The identity id making the request. Cross-referenced against identities[].id at load time.

target_resource.description: The resource id being accessed. Cross-referenced against resources[].resource_id at load time.

expected_outcome.description: Binary verdict, matching this project's binary-verdict convention (D20).
